hero_kpi_rationale: The loan book is the primary driver of net interest income, the core of the banking business model. Its growth directly reflects balance sheet expansion and controlled risk-taking in credit markets.

kpis.name: Loan Book
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans granted to customers and not yet repaid.
kpis.description: The loan book grew 4% year-on-year, driven by commercial and real estate demand.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income earned on loans and deposit costs, expressed as a percentage of earning assets.
kpis.description: NIM improved by 15 basis points, supported by higher policy rates and active balance sheet management.
kpis.signal: Improvement in margin driven by rate environment

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by shareholders' equity, measuring return for shareholders.
kpis.description: ROE reaches 10.8% in 2025, driven by improved operating profitability and cost discipline.

kpis.name: Common Equity Tier 1 Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measure of financial strength, comparing core equity to risk-weighted assets.
kpis.description: The CET1 ratio remains strong at 12.4%, reflecting prudent risk management and a comfortable liquidity position.
kpis.signal: Strong capital position enabling dividends and buybacks

kpis.name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of operating expenses in total revenues. A lower ratio indicates higher efficiency.
kpis.description: The cost-to-income ratio declined to 61%, driven by efficiency gains and increased digitalization of services.

kpis.name: Gross Non-Performing Assets Ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of loans in default (over 90 days past due) in the total loan portfolio.
kpis.description: The GNPA ratio improved slightly to 1.7%, indicating sound credit discipline and a stable economic environment.

kpis.name: Cumulative Share Buybacks
kpis.explanation: Total amount spent on repurchasing shares over multiple years to return capital to shareholders.
kpis.description: $25 billion in share buybacks executed over the past three years, supporting total shareholder return.

kpis.name: Employee Engagement Rate
kpis.explanation: Metric measuring employee satisfaction and involvement within the company.
kpis.description: The engagement index reached 86% in 2025, with 86% participation in the annual survey.

kpis.name: Compensation Expense
kpis.explanation: Total amount of salaries, bonuses, and benefits paid to employees.
kpis.description: Compensation expense reached $42.3 billion in 2025, representing 61% of non-financial expenses.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual total revenue, extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $113.097 Bn in the last fiscal year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Net income of $30.509 Bn in the last fiscal year.
